name: Grandmom's Strawberry Cake
author: Chris Crawley
steps: Justin Crawley loves this cake. Makes a rich, heavy cake.
For the frozen strawberries, use little frozen box if you can find.
Mix the cake mix, oil, eggs, jello, flour, water, and half of the frozen strawberries well.
Fill cake rounds or 9x13 pan and bake at 350° until done.
To make the icing, mix the powdered sugar, margarine, and remaining frozen strawberries (may use juice only) well.
Ice the cake. Serve with vanilla ice cream and strawberries.
